newsitem.title: USA: Fujitsu Network in $130 mln acquisition of Nexion.
newsitem.headline: Fujitsu Network in $130 mln acquisition of Nexion.

text.p: Fujitsu Network Communications Inc, a manufacturer of fiber-optic equipment, said on Tuesday that it had completed the acquisition of the business of Ascorn Nexion Inc for roughly $130 million.
Fujitsu Network, a unit of Fujitsu Ltd, said it will operate Nexion as a subsidiary, called Fujitsu Nexion Inc.
Nexion, acquired from its Swiss parent company, Ascom Holding AG, manufactures the NEXEN 8000 switch to integrate multiple services onto a single network.
"The acquisition of Nexion gives Fujitsu a stong product to round out its solutions for the public network carrier market in North America," Fujitsu said in a statement.
